rows.text: tail-jumps to the function at `001FB830` + 0xA with `rcx` = qword `01F7F4D0` and `rdx` = the qword at `[rcx]`

returns 0 when `ecx` is 0; otherwise calls the function at `005E3040` + 0x26 with `rcx` = `ecx`*8 and `edx` = 8 and returns its result, which when non-null first receives `r8d` qwords copied from `rdx` (each destination slot written only when non-null) with the remaining `ecx` minus `r8d` qwords zeroed

calls the function at `00616210` + 0x9 with the incoming `rcx` (other register arguments passed through unchanged), then stores the fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth and ninth (stack) arguments as dwords to `+0x20`, `+0x24`, `+0x28`, `+0x2C` and `+0x30` of `rcx`, and returns `rcx`

notes: 005E3040: the copy loop's per-slot null test is on the destination pointer (always non-null in practice); the zero-fill count is the 32-bit difference ecx - r8d, skipped when it is 0; rep stosq not used as an anchor to avoid a prefix/mnemonic ambiguity. 00616210: stack arguments read at [rsp+0x50..0x70] after push rbx and sub rsp,0x20 (fifth through ninth); the call's own return value is discarded.
